summary: XORTX Therapeutics Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting it received a Nasdaq compliance letter confirming the minimum bid price requirement (Rule 5550(a)(2)) has been cured following a 1-for-5 reverse stock split effective April 6, 2026. The filing is a routine update on continued listing requirements with no special situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or strategic transaction. No terms, deal structure, or board recommendation are involved. This is an administrative compliance notice with no actionable corporate event for special-situations analysis.
